meanings.en: family name Fang, used for Professor Fang
meanings.note: Pinyin: fāng. The actual teacher is addressed by his surname plus老师. The source does not establish his family lineage or the origin of his personal name.

examples.trans: Professor Fang asked me to wait for you so we could go together.

meanings.en: the student Bu Xiaogu, addressed as小谷 in this excerpt
meanings.note: Pinyin: Bù Xiǎogǔ; short name Xiǎogǔ. The source identity captions associate布小谷 with her classmate秦箫; the professor uses her short name小谷. The choice and etymology of her personal name are unexplained.

meanings.en: the student Qin Xiao, a classmate of Bu Xiaogu
meanings.note: Pinyin: Qín Xiāo. The name is visible in the source identity caption and spoken by the professor. Its name-choice history is not explained; individual character meanings are not assigned as a translation of this person’s name.

examples.trans: Qin Xiao is waiting for Xiaogu.
